claims: As of 2024–2026, NASA astronauts are paid based on the U.S. government’s General Schedule (GS) scale.
NASA astronauts typically earn around $152,258 per year.
NASA astronauts' average salary is approximately $152,258 per year (2024–2026 data).
FederalPay.org estimates indicate a salary range of roughly $89,693 to $122,336+ for astronauts depending on experience.
Salaries for civilian astronauts range from GS-11 to GS-14/15 levels.
Military astronauts receive pay and benefits from their respective branches.
There is no overtime pay for space missions.
Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronauts have salaries ranging from $97,100 to $189,600 (2023 data).
Astronauts do not receive bonuses for spaceflight.
Astronauts are paid their standard salary while in space.
Transportation and lodging are provided to astronauts while in space.
Astronauts receive a roughly $5/day stipend for incidentals while in space.
Civilian astronauts are paid according to the federal GS-11 to GS-15 scale.
Civilian astronaut pay is influenced by locality pay (e.g., Houston, TX).
Active-duty military astronauts remain on their service payroll.
Military service payroll can differ from civilian civil service pay.
Astronaut benefits include federal health plans.
Astronaut benefits include a three-tiered retirement plan.
